additional_info.subject: RE: ID0382401-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312561850/26] FEC_VOLTAGE_TO_LOW_IN_CHARGINGPHASE CRM:01811000365
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I hope this message finds you well.
I wanted to inform you that the charger is currently offline on SCB, and I’m unable to check its status remotely. Could you please try rebooting the charger manually on site?
If the charger does not come back online after the reboot, please check the XF3 router (Siemens) by accessing the webUI of the Teltonika router.
Once the charger is online, ensure to check the connection of the DC2 cable and measure the voltage at DC2 plus and DC2 minus to determine if there’s a short circuit..
Additionally, please refer to the attached image and check all connections. If everything looks okay, swap TF1 with TF2 to assess the health of TF2. If that does not resolve the issue, we may need to replace TF2, so please carry a spare with you.
MLFB No.
If you need any assistance during the intervention,
please feel free to reach out.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare

additional_info.subject: 0382401 - ID0382401-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312561850/26] FEC_VOLTAGE_TO_LOW_IN_CHARGINGPHASE CRM:00568000133
additional_info.body:
Hello,
After intervention today with François in support, please find the resume :
At the arrival on site on charger 7 , I tried twice to charge ma car but without succes on DC2
I tried to charge on DC1 and it works at the first time.
In the logs we can see a issue on TF2 ( transducer) so we switched off the charger and inverse TF1 by TF2 to check if the issue switch to DC1 instead DC2 and it was the case .
So we tried with Jessica's car to charge on DC1 => doesn't work
Tried to charge on DC2 => it worked as expected with average 80kW on DC2
To conclude the issue foward the device in Defect TF2 so we have to replace TF2 to solve the issue .
PS: The charger is in the last configuration test, to explain the TF2 is at the place TF1 in Right side and TF1 is at the place to TF2 ( at the left side) as describe by the pictures in attachment.
The DC1 outlet has been disabled on the charger
So for next intervention, please replace the TF2 by a new one and translate the TF2 to Left side ( instead TF1 now in place) and put the TF1 on the right side ( instead TF2 now in place) .
With best regards,

additional_info.subject: 0382401 - ID0382401-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312561850/26] FEC_VOLTAGE_TO_LOW_IN_CHARGINGPHASE CRM:00568000139
additional_info.body:
Bonjour,
Suite au remplacement ce jour du Tranducer TF2 pour résoudre le problème de charge sur DC2, nous avons lancé des test de charge sur un véhicule et après deux minutes à 130Kw , la borne s'arrête avec erreur capteur de température.
Après inspection du connecteur nous avons constaté une dégradation au niveau d'un pole DC dans le connecteur, une des deux pin DC est dégradée et la puissance est transmise a travers une partie métallique très réduite, ce qui explique l'échauffement du connecteur et la mise en sécurité de la borne .
Cette  dégradation ne peut pas être prise en compte dans le cadre de la garantie.
La sortie DC2 de la borne a été désactivée pour des aspects sécurité en attendant le changement du câble.
With best regards,
